Game runs smoothly, one of the best looper games I've seen, wish there was an endless mode for longer runs, or a way to extend the 3-day rounds so more items and levels are possible.
The item designs and traits are well thought out, some items have a "broken" or "Cursed" counterpart with a huge bonus and and larger drawback. Hoping to see more weapon variants in the future, maybe more firearms, hammers, bows, swords, staves. Otherwise, great game.

At time of review this game is in active development. The game has heaps of potential. If it looks fun and you can afford it, support it.

-My current thoughts are it just needs more support and development, I enjoy the core concept and just want more.

-In my wildest dreams: Id like to see a game mode where you defend one of the camps. Just make it much larger, and a defensive position. I envision either your heroes with AI stationed at entrances for you to beef up and move around to spots that are leaking. Nodes that refresh or buffs being dropped by bigger(harder) enemies that attack. I know part of the core concept is open world, that's why i said in my wildest dreams. I like the idea of going out and building up your team to ultimately face waves of enemies in an endless thing. Almost like what Fortnite save the world did for home bases without the building, just the waves increasing in difficulty LORT style. I genuinely think the gaming world is missing something that combines roguelite constantly dead and progression leading into a defensive style of endurance test.
Pretty fun game, runs pretty smooth, not too hard and not to easy. eager for each new patch and new heroes.

This game is still missing a lot of content, but it is soo much fun.  But they do have a roadmap for future updates, so hopefully those updates come quickly.  There is definitely a god base to improve on.

This game is certainly fun, I've been playing on the normal difficulty and enjoy cliff the most, but havent been able to get past stage 2 solely due to goblin thieves, since they slow you on hit and can just appear, as well as being the sole spawned enemy by the stage 2 boss, which can make them invulnerable to damage, the boss itself isnt even too much of an issue, my entire timeline of deaths in stage 2 is always to goblin thieves, would absolutely enjoy it more if they just didnt slow you on hit

A fun but basic roguelite similar to Risk of Rain 2 but with gratuitous amounts of silly Zoomer humor. It plays fine and the powerups can result in some wacky chaos, but the weapons are strictly linear. The enemies are also basically reskins repeated throughout each level, with the bosses just being bigger versions of normal enemies with extra voice lines and 1-2 unique attacks.

It's a fun party game due to the 8 player co-op, but it's currently pretty basic and there is virtually no variety between runs besides what powerup randomness happens. The normal difficulty is also VERY high solo, to the point where the first common enemies you see at the start of the run can kill you in seconds, and several enemies have obnoxiously cheap attacks (in particular net throwers and dive bombers during end of level escapes). Unless you get lucky with powerups, you are likely to always be on the back foot. I am glad they added an Easy mode, and for solo play it's virtually the only option.
